key_highlights: ASX shed $90B in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern
Oil prices exploded on Strait of Hormuz crisis; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c
Housing prices crashing at high end while first-home buyers surge; RBA monitoring rental inflation
US CPI sticky, Fed rate-hike bets jumping, global bond yields soaring
Australian businesses reporting elevated fear; Santos preservation seen as national sacrifice
Mining cap-raise activity surging via Canaccord-led dash for cash

sectors.trend: Sharp downturn; iron ore bloodletting, ASX miners leading the $90B weekly loss. Cap-raise activity surging as smaller miners seek liquidity. Gold-silver explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from falling iron ore. Smaller miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) volatile. Gold names offer relative hedge amid rate uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Banks sending ASX tumbling alongside miners. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears compressing valuations. RBA rental inflation concern adds policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate volatility. Net interest margin outlook mixed. Superannuation policy debate adds regulatory risk.

sectors.trend: Oil prices exploding on Strait of Hormuz crisis and Saudi bypass threat. Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c. Santos preservation and softened gas supply rules support domestic energy names.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from gas supply rule easing. Oil-linked names gain but fuel cost inflation pressures consumers.

sectors.trend: Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on staples. Housing crash boosting first-home buyers but high-end property hit hardest. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin squeeze from input costs. REITs (GPG.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rental inflation and high-end property weakness.

sectors.trend: ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. HIVE scaling AI cloud via BUZZ HPC. Critical Resources battery tech passing month-long test.
sectors.implications: Speculative small-caps active but liquidity risk elevated in risk-off environment. Battery tech (Critical Resources) offers structural growth theme.

key_themes: Global rate-hike cycle accelerating (US CPI sticky, bond yields soaring)
Oil supply shock from Middle East geopolitical risk
Iron ore demand weakness amid Chinese inflation surge
Australian housing bifurcation: high-end crash vs affordable resilience
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and fuel prices
Superannuation policy debate intensifying ahead of potential reform
Mining sector liquidity stress via cap raises

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration and floating-rate instruments. Monitor RBA response to rental inflation.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil supply shock / Strait of Hormuz crisis
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel-cost exposure; overweight domestic gas (WDS.AX, STO.AX) as structural beneficiaries.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and critical minerals.
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies with limited import dependency.
Avoid high-end property REITs; monitor rental yield compression. First-home buyer surge may support affordable housing names.
Avoid small-cap miners with pending cap raises; favour well-funded majors or cash-flow-positive explorers.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic gas producers amid supply rule easing and oil shock
opportunities.rationale: Softened gas supply rules and oil price surge support gas substitution demand; Santos preservation signals policy support

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and critical minerals as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and Chinese inflation surge favour gold; battery tech (Critical Resources) offers structural growth

opportunities.recommendation: Selective first-home buyer / affordable housing exposure
opportunities.rationale: Housing crash at high end but first-home buyers surging; affordable segment proving resilient

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore major exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting underway; Chinese inflation and demand weakness create downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk; reduce long-duration bond and high-beta equity exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Global rate-hike cycle and soaring yields create valuation compression risk across ASX

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid small-cap miners with pending cap raises
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led mining cap-raise dash signals liquidity stress; dilution risk elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain AUD hedge on import-heavy positions
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; further depreciation raises input costs for consumers and manufacturers

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil shock, rate-hike fears, and iron ore weakness create headwinds. RBA policy dilemma (rental inflation vs growth) adds uncertainty. Expect volatility around ^AXJO with potential 5–8% further downside before stabilisation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil shock resolves and iron ore stabilises. Domestic gas, gold, and critical minerals offer structural themes. Housing correction may create entry points in affordable REITs. Superannuation reform debate could create policy tailwinds for financials.
